user.title: Set up Vector
user.description:
Choose one mode only.

Host is required because Home Assistant connects directly to the robot on your local network.

EscapePod/Wire-pod mode: Fill Robot name and Host. Serial is optional but recommended for stable identification and generation detection.

DDL cloud mode: Fill Robot name, Host, Email, and Password. Email/Password are only used to fetch cloud auth data; the robot connection is still local via Host.

Only fill Email and Password for DDL cloud mode. Leave both empty for EscapePod/Wire-pod mode.
